title: gflow cycle: protected, rc, keep release branches
rules: main, develop, release/* and hotfix/* change only through PRs. Each leg of a finish or sync travels on landing/<source>-into-<target>: gflow creates it from the source, merges the target in (also when that changes nothing), and opens the PR. A reviewer merges it with a MERGE COMMIT.
Every version change travels on version/X.Y.Z-into-<target>: the release cut and the hotfix start. gflow squash-merges it and deletes it in the same call.
Develop gets no version bump. Its VERSION file only changes when a release or hotfix lands on it.

Every tag sits on the release or hotfix branch, on the exact commit that was tested, never on a merge commit on main. The merge into main carries the tagged commit as its second parent. A version change's tag sits on its version branch's squash commit.

Tags: rc sets VERSION X.Y.0 once, at the cut. The cut tags vX.Y.0-rc.1; each bump only tags the tip vX.Y.0-rc.N, with no version change; finish tags the clean vX.Y.0 on the release tip before any merge.
gflow finish refuses a release with commits past its last tag. gflow bump is the remedy.
gflow sync brings the release into develop without finishing it. When the release moves on after a sync, finish refreshes the develop landing and opens a fresh PR.
A hotfix gets its version from the last shipped tag at start. Its one tag goes on the hotfix tip when finish starts, before any merge.
Landing order: main first, then each open release, then develop. A release lands on main, then develop. A hotfix lands on main, then every open release, then develop.
On a VERSION conflict the developer keeps the VERSION of the branch the merge lands on.

deployVersions: what gflow deploy-version prints after the action, as X.Y.Z+N, on develop, each open release and hotfix branch, and each open work branch. Develop prints the next minor after the highest tag; a release prints its latest tag; a hotfix prints its own version. N counts the branch's own first-parent commits. A work branch counts like the branch it lands on.

Hooks: release-start, release-bump, release-finish and hotfix-finish each run once per tag, after the event is merged, tagged, pushed and cleaned up. A work finish, a sync, and a finish that still waits for a landing PR run none.
keep-release-branches=true keeps release/* and hotfix/* after finish.
